problem.title: KISS-ICP cluster discovery on KITTI Odom seq 07 full (1102 frames)
problem.question: Does LiTAMIN2 T1 (voxel=0.5 + iter=12) recipe pattern transfer to KISS-ICP on KITTI Odom?

variants.label: balanced (default)
variants.note: Adaptive sigma min/mean/max=0.15/1.95752/3.26766; correspondence_multiplier=1; neighbor_voxel_radius=auto; vertical_angle_correction_deg=0; mulran_deskew=off; deskewed_frames=0; deskew_timestamp_fallbacks=0; motion_guard=off; motion_guard_rejections=0; adaptive_motion_guard_acceptances=0; end_to_end_fps=3.3796; algorithm_fps=3.77529.
